mechanism.cancel_time: maintenance stores the current PolicyDecision as pending_replacement
mechanism.latency_interval: market depth may change while cancel response is pending
mechanism.m4_guard: validate_passive_target correctly rejected the stale ask with ask_not_passive
mechanism.observed_failure: stored ask target was no longer passive against the current best bid
mechanism.response_time: the stored PolicyDecision is submitted directly without recomputing targets against the current book
